subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should interrupted subagent completion announce delivery be reconciled as a non-running `killed` parent-topic session and always run tool-free across CLI, embedded, and Codex native paths?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes stored session state and a security-sensitive tool boundary, which requires maintainer ownership rather than an automated merge-only verdict.

options.title: Accept after lint rerun
options.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land if maintainers agree with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery.

options.title: Choose another terminal state
options.body: If `killed` is not the desired persisted state for delivery-only announce aborts, adjust the recovery patch before merge.

options.title: Pause for broader recovery design
options.body: If maintainers want one model for all inter-session delivery recovery instead of an announce-specific marker, pause this PR and route that design first.

recommendation.title: Accept after lint rerun
recommendation.body: Rerun or clear `check-lint`, then land if maintainers agree with `announceLastRun`, `killed` reconciliation, and tool-free announce delivery.
